reviews.title: great board
reviews.comment: I bought this motherboard twice, long story, but the first one broke from a SATA hot swap failure, after the RMA it wouldnt boot, I was in a rush RMA took a month and a half, so just wanted it to work, bought a matching replacemnt, and was having the same boot issue as the one I RMA'd, turns out this thing, measurs and sets the ram speed on the first boot, so the first boot, may take like 30 seconds to show a picture once booted, be patient it was working fine as was the RMA'd one.
reviews.author: Matt J

reviews.title: Excelente producto
reviews.comment: Excelente producto, llega antes de tiempo, empacado muy bien, se ve la calidad, me funciono 100% con los demás dispositivos que adquirí para el uso, su BIOS fácil de entender.
reviews.author: fernando torres

reviews.title: Good board for work and play
reviews.comment: Great motherboard, easy to install, it has lots of USB ports and the WiFi is rev 6, the chipset is the B850 and there is a good chance than when zen 6 launches it will be supported via bios update, overall very satisfied
reviews.author: Pablo Javier Salazar Valencia
